claims.value: Gnptg-KO MEF <n> M6P secretome (light) / WT MEF <n> M6P secretome (heavy), n = 1-3 from SA_HH_Bead<n>
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol: 'MEF cells from three Gnptgko and three wild-type mice. Gnptgko and wild-type MEF were labelled with light and heavy SILAC amino acids, respectively. The media were concentrated ... and mixed. M6P containing proteins were captured on scFv M6P-1 antibody ... beads'. Three raw files SA_HH_Bead1-3, each its own MaxQuant Experiment (summary.txt: Bead3=1, Bead2=2, Bead1=3). Source name index n follows the Bead number in the file name, not the MaxQuant experiment number; which mouse went into which bead is not stated.

claims.value: SILAC light (Gnptg knockout) / SILAC heavy (wild type)
claims.evidence: Explicit: PRIDE protocol 'Gnptgko and wild-type MEF were labelled with light and heavy SILAC amino acids, respectively'. Multiplexing verified (rule 14): summary.txt Multiplicity 2, Labels1 Arg10;Lys6 for all 3 raws. Data cross-check (rule 6): proteinGroups.txt Arsb Intensity H 195440 vs L 33108; Hexb ratio H/L 2.09, Glb1 2.74 (WT>KO in the M6P-enriched secretome) -- consistent with the paper abstract ('A subset of these lysosomal enzymes show also reduced M6P modifications ... among them ... arylsulfatase B') and dmm2020 (Arsb, Glb1, Hexb mistargeted in Gnptgko fibroblasts), i.e. KO = light.
PRIDE protocol: three Gnptgko and three wild-type MEF; abstract: 'fibroblasts of wild-type and Gnptg ko mice'. Genotype is the compared variable (factor).

Three KO and three WT mice and three separately searched bead runs; numbered 1..3 per factor-value group (spec README.adoc:330, campaign rule 3). The paper Methods could not be read, so one-mouse-per-bead pairing is inferred from 3 mice per genotype + 3 bead runs (see limitations).
PRIDE organisms NEWT:10090; mouse MEF.

MEF = mouse embryonic fibroblasts (PRIDE keyword 'mouse embryonic fibroblasts'; dmm2020: 'embryonic fibroblasts from Gnptgko mice ... (Di Lorenzo et al., 2018)'). Exact embryonic day not available (paper Methods unreachable), so the generic EFO:0005857 term is used.
PRIDE: 'MEF cells'; CL:2000042.
Primary cultured MEF (not an established cell line); the analysed material is their conditioned medium, recorded in characteristics[cellular component].

PRIDE title 'Mannose 6-phosphate containing proteins'; keywords 'Secreted proteins'; protocol: media concentrated and M6P proteins captured -> the measured sample is the M6P-enriched secretome (GO:0005576). Custom characteristics column (spec 'Extending Templates'), precedent PXD001345 characteristics[cellular component].

Abstract: 'fibroblasts of wild-type and Gnptg ko mice mimicking the lysosomal storage disorder mucolipidosis III'; PRIDE description: MLIII gamma is caused by GNPTG mutations. MONDO:0009652 GNPTG-mucolipidosis for the KO model; WT rows 'normal' (PRIDE diseases field 'Disease free' is the project-level dropdown).

dmm2020 Methods (same lab, same mouse line): 'Gnptgko (C57Bl/6) ... mice have been described previously (... Di Lorenzo et al., 2018)'. Wild-type controls assumed same background as the KO line (littermate/strain controls are not explicitly described for the MEF in the reachable text).
PRIDE instruments LTQ Orbitrap Velos; raw header string 'LTQ Orbitrap Velos MS' in SA_HH_Bead1.raw.
PRIDE: 'incubated overnight with trypsin for digestion'. MaxQuant search rule Trypsin/P (summary.txt) recorded as a note; SDRF records the digestion enzyme (campaign rule 2).

limitations: Paper full text (Di Lorenzo et al. 2018, MCP) is not in the OA subset and the publisher/Europe PMC PDF returned HTTP 403 (not bypassed); only the abstract was read. Sample design comes from the PRIDE protocol and the deposited MaxQuant output.

Biological replicate / pairing: the PRIDE protocol states three KO and three WT mice; 3 bead runs exist. That each bead holds one distinct KO + one distinct WT medium is inferred, not stated; if the media were pooled and split over beads, the replicates would be technical.
Bead<n> -> mouse identity is not documented; source index n follows the file name. MaxQuant Experiment numbers are reversed (Bead3=1, Bead1=3).
Lysine label: PRIDE prose says 13C6 15N2 lysine; the deposited MaxQuant search used Lys6 and the data support Lys6 (see claim). Encoded per deposited search.
Precursor mass tolerance not available: parameters.txt does not list it and no mqpar.xml was deposited ('standard settings' per PRIDE). convert-openms therefore exits 1.
Embryonic day of MEF isolation, sex and passage number not available.
Strain C57BL/6 comes from the same lab's 2020 paper describing the Gnptgko line, not from this study's text.

PXD007546 and PXD007547 are two deposits of the same study (secretome vs lysosome arms): no raw overlap (different file names, sizes and SHA-1 checksums). Whether the same three KO/WT MEF lines were used in both arms is not stated, so source names are not shared across the two SDRFs.
